notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.7
notes.notes:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.7[/h1][p][/p][p][b][i]Tycoons![/i]  We have just delivered Railway Empire 2’s Update 1.7 to Steam, Microsoft Store, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery). This update includes a new manual warehouse operation mode, a new [/b]gameplay option to disable “Small breakdowns” and fixes several gameplay and crash issues.  [b]
[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1644320/view/521968650881597975?l=english"][/dynamiclink][b] Please find the full Changelog below.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added an alternate warehouse operation mode. When “Automatic Distribution” is turned off, warehouses can be used as permanent stores (similar to how warehouses functioned in Railway Empire 1) and goods will no longer use them for automatic travel to their destination. Both modes are always available from the warehouse menu and a combination of both modes can be used on the same map. Only one warehouse set to one of the modes can be used per station.[/p][/*][*][p]Added: Difficulty setting “AI Behavior” in Custom Games. Minor improvements for the AI in custom games can now be enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Difficulty setting “Connection Bonus”. If set to “off”, there will be no connection bonuses offered during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Pause Auctions” to Options menu. When set to “on” the auction timer will pause when the game is paused AND the player is not the highest bidder in the current auction, so that they have time to react.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Gameplay option to disable “Small breakdowns”. Small breakdowns can occur for engines with a maintenance limit between 90% and 50%. If disabled, engines will never break down when above 50% maintenance limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Graphics Option “Moving Sun”. When enabled the sun always keeps the same angle in relation to the camera to ensure consistent scene lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Locked regions are now always visible in track construction.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved terrain contrast overall to make hills and mountains more visible on high zoom levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new goods icons to task texts next to the spelled-out name of the good, to increase clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Goods that are on the way to a foundable rural business are now communicated by a tooltip, accessible via the corresponding interface, similar to the tooltip accessible via the stock and demand overview for existing cities.

[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Bug-Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a specific order of commands allowed the speed in ride-along camera to be higher than 1x game speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where people at stations were not always visible when using the ride-along camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue related to moving the camera before the automatic camera at the start of a new map is done.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused reduced FPS when changing a selected train to manual loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a wrong button was displayed, suggesting a “set maintenance limit” option being available at buildings unrelated to maintenance.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Localization] Fixed an issue where “Rice” was not correctly translated in Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where map decorations like boulders, ruins, small buildings, etc. would not vanish if the player laid track next to them. Trains now no longer clip through them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, when editing rail lines if too many goods were available in a city, they did not fit in the available space anymore, they will now slowly pan back and forth, so that all goods can be seen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rural businesses visible working areas were not adjusting based on business size anymore. Larger businesses now have more attached working areas again (e.g. fields or clay pits).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the train breaking sound effects were looped when pausing during playback.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Controller only Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]\[Controller only] Fixed a blocker in the first Tutorial when the user accidentally closed the rail line creation menu before building the first rail line.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Controller only] Removed a prompt to build overhead lines from rail builder when electrification was not active.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Controller only] Fixed an issue where Contour Lines did not reliably turn off correctly when leaving construction mode.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Controller only] Fixed an issue where the “Scroll” button legend was missing in some building screens.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]DLC-specific Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]\[All DLCs] Region-specific fitting goods are now impacted by refrigerator cars.[/p][/*][*][p]\[All DLCs] Regional specific bridges are now applied to all DLC maps accordingly[/p][/*][*][p]\[High Voltage only] Fixed a very rare issue where extra overhead lines were spawned parallel to the tracks.

[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 – India DLC Release
notes.notes:
[h1]All Aboard! Railway Empire 2 Launches DLC Set in Vibrant India [/h1]

[h2]Master India’s railways with authentic locomotives and three new scenarios in Railway Empire 2 – India[/h2]  

[previewyoutube=UJsDauVAp9E;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Today we have released the third DLC for Railway Empire 2.[/b] [b]In Railway Empire 2 – India[/b], you navigate the turbulent mid–1800s, witnessing the shifting power balance between the East India Company and the Crown while capitalising on the unique resources in a massive new Indian market. [b]Railway Empire 2 – India is Out Now on PC, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S. [/b]

[b]In Railway Empire 2 – India[/b], you venture into a new territory for the series, the Indian subcontinent. The vast Indian landscape is playable on a single, colossal map or one of four detailed map sections and the DLC also includes [b]three new campaign scenarios “Foreign Regency” (1840), “Karmic Justice” (s1854) and “Colours of India” (1865)[/b]. The India also DLC introduces [b]four authentic Indian locomotives[/b], including the [b]“Fairy Queen” and the BNR class N[/b], along with five imported locomotives reimagined for the new region. The versatile lands of India provide opportunities to transport new regional goods including [b]Raw Silk, Naan, and Chai Tea[/b] with specific locations which that [b]allow two possible productions to be swapped[/b], allowing you to further shape how the Indian economy develops.  

Whether you are shipping goods across the rolling plains of the Ganges or connecting megacities teeming with commerce, [b]Railway Empire 2 – India[/b] brings a wealth of content and strategy to test even the sharpest of tycoons.  

[u][b]Railway Empire 2 – India is available now![/b][/u] Grab your ticket and embark on a grand journey through one of the world’s most colourful regions. 

[b]Railway Empire 2 - India is Out Now on PC, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S, and will cost €10.99|£8.99, with a 10% launch discount for the first week on Steam. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677570/Railway_Empire_2__India/

[h3]Railway Empire 2 - India Features: [/h3]
[list][*][b] A new look:[/b] Railway Empire 2 – India takes you into the vast Indian subcontinent, filled to the brim with exotic and colourful treasures and buzzing mega-cities that wait to be explored 
[*] [b]Steaming Goodness:[/b] Utilize 4 new authentic Indian locomotives such as the “Fairy Queen” and the BNR class N, plus 5 imported locomotives that are reimagined to fit the new region.  
[*] [b]Bangalore, Calcutta and Bombay:[/b] The DLC introduces 3 comprehensive, fully voiced scenarios, “Foreign Regency” (starting 1840), “Karmic Justice” (starting 1854) and “Colours of India” (1865). 
[*] [b]Explore & Expand: [/b]Plough through the vastness of the Indian countryside with the regional map "India" – playable as one huge map and 4 detailed map sections.  
[*] [b]Treasures of India:[/b] Transport 16 new regional products from Raw Silk and traditional Naan bread to spiced Chai tea. Some versatile locations will also now allow you to swap between two possible productions, allowing you to further shape how the Indian economy develops. 
[*] [b]Sitars & Strings:[/b] 20 new themed music tracks and jingles to get you in the mood for the new setting. [/list]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.5
notes.notes:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.5[/h1]

[i]Tycoons![/i]

We have just delivered Railway Empire 2’s Update 1.5 to Steam, Xbox Game Pass across console and PC Game Pass for PC, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery).
This update includes[b] improvements to train logic[/b], and [b]a fix for Manual signals impeding traffic and causing traffic jams[/b] when built too close to supply depots, among other things.

[b]Please find the full Changelog below.[/b]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Multiple improvements to the train logic, removing several traffic jams especially around supply towers, grid irons and train stations (including trains showing “Train waiting on itself” notifications).
[*] The maximum amount of research points granted until 1930 has been adjusted to reflect the increased need with the High Voltage and the Journey to the East DLC. 
[*] Added: The Station clocks now display the current system time.[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where coal wagons during the early ages of 1830 looked too modern.
[*] Fixed an issue where manual signals impeded traffic and caused traffic jams when they were built too close to supply depots.
[*] Fixed an issue where the refund message did not display multiple refunds when deleting multiple trains at once.
[*] Fixed an issue where the manual loading indication allowed you to mark goods to be unloaded at a station that has no demand for it.
[*] Fixed an issue where the achievement “Three Cheers for Progress” was not unlocking correctly. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Balance (last 7 days)” overlay did not display the production cost correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “New Saboteur” tooltip did not appear directly underneath his icon after recruitment.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game continued running in the background after opening the Tips & Tricks menu.

[*] [Journey To The East DLC] Fixed an issue where the quarterly report did not include the luxury passenger revenue.
[*] [Journey To The East DLC] Fixed an issue where the White Nougat factory was not available after loading an older save game.
[*] [High Voltage DLC] Fixed an issue where the electric pole placement at parallel rails was not correct.
[*] [High Voltage DLC] Fixed an issue where the electric pole placement at train stations was not correct.
[*] [High Voltage DLC][Controller only] Fixed an issue where the “Build Overhead Lines On/Off” and “Pause game” were on the same controller button. “Build Overhead Lines On/Off” now requires holding the left stick during track construction instead of pressing the left stick.
[*] [High Voltage DLC][Controller only] Fixed an issue, where the electric train icon indication in the “Locomotive Selection” screen when editing a rail line was missing.
[*] [Controller only] Fixed an issue where the left button to cycle through stations was mispositioned when playing with controller.
[*] [PC only] Fixed an issue where the key bindings did not differentiate between the normal “+” icon and the Numpad “+” icon.
[*] [PC only] Changed the key binding for tilting the camera to prevent the double usage of the key within the tutorial.[/list]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Quality of Life Update 1.3[/h1]

[i]Tycoons![/i]

We have just delivered Railway Empire 2’s Update 1.3 to Steam, Xbox Game Pass across console and PC Game Pass for PC, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery).
This update includes the addition of several new shortcuts, an option to hide the UI, and trains now bypassing stations if they didn’t plan to stop at them and the bypass track isn’t too long.

[i]Please find the full Changelog below.[/i]

[h3]Quality of Life Additions[/h3]
[list][*][b][u]Added: More custom shortcuts[/u][/b]
Multiple new keyboard shortcuts have been added to the game. These shortcuts can be viewed and customized in the Key Bindings menu: Options -> Controls -> Keyboard Layout
[list][*]Construct New Rail Line: Z
Open the “Create New Rail Line” panel.
[*]Demolish: ENTF
Opens the demolish panel.
[*]Global Confirm: RETURN
Affects all modal dialogs, as well as in track building.
[*]Cycle Rail Lines + : PgUp
In the World View: Cycle through the trainlines to the right
[*]Cycle Rail Lines - : PgDn
In the World View: Cycle through the trainlines to the left
[*]Adjust rail height + : POS_1
During rail building, while hovering over a rail point, increase the height of the track.
[*]Adjust rail height - : END
During rail building, while hovering over a rail point, decrease the height of the track.
[*]Rotate Building + : I
In building mode, rotates the building to the right.
[*]Rotate Building - : O
In building mode, rotates the building to the left.
[*]Tilt Camera + : Y
Tilts the camera upwards.
[*]Tilt Camera - : X
Tilts the camera downwards.
[*]Open Task List Screen: F2
Opens the Task List Screen.
[*]Open Company Screen: F3
Opens the Company Screen.
[*]Open Research Screen: F4
Opens the Research Screen.
[*]Open Engine Shed Screen: F5
Opens the Engine Shed Screen.
[*]Open Personnel Screen: F6
Opens the Personnel Screen.
[*]Open Multiplayer Screen: F7
Opens the Multiplayer Screen.
[*]Open Rail Lines List: J
Opens the list of all rail lines to the left information interface.
[*]Open City List: K
Opens the list of all cities to the left information interface.
[*]Open Flow of Good: L
Opens the flow of goods display to the left information interface.
[*]Open Additional Overlays: Ö
Opens the additional overlays to the left information interface. [/list]
[*][b][u]Added: Option to hide UI[/u][/b] 
The “Photo mode on/off” option has been added to the key bindings menu. It is now possible to hide the UI by pressing the F11 key.
[*][b][u]Added: New option "Align Railpoints to terrain", where track construction will follow the incline of the terrain rather than cutting straight through every hill and across every drop[/u] [/b]
The “Align Railpoints to terrain” option has been added to the Gameplay options menu. If set to “on”, when placing a “Track Point” on a planned track segment which deviates from the terrain’s height, the “Track Points” height is set to the terrain’s height.
[*][b][u]Added: Trains avoid stations now if they do not plan to stop at that station and if there is a quick way around[/u][/b] 
Then train logic and behavior has been changed. If trains do not plan to stop at a city train station, they will now try to use an alternative track to bypass the city train station. The alternative track must not be too long,  or they will fall back to drive through the train station.
[*][b][u]Added: New “Track utilization” overlay[/u][/b]
The “Track utilization” checkbox has been added to the “Additional Overlay” menu (This menu can be accessed by pressing on the “i” icon in the top left corner of the screen). When this option is turned on, tracks will now be given a colour based on their train usage: from white (low usage) to dark red (high usage).
[*][b][u]Added: New Highlights for tunnels, bridges, and gridirons in track construction[/u][/b] 
While being in “Track Construction” mode, certain track parts are now coloured differently to allow for a better distinction between them. Gridirons are now coloured in an orange & white dashed line, Tunnels in a purple & white dashed line, and Bridges in a blue & white dashed line.
[*][b][u]Added: New “Connected citizens” metric to company overview[/u][/b] 
The “Connected Citizens” information has been added to the “Company” menu. The number of citizens connected by the player will now be displayed there.
[*][b][u]Added: New “Number of businesses” metric to “Flow of goods”[/u] [/b]
The “Number of businesses” information has been added to the “Flow of Goods” menu. When selecting a resource, the total number of businesses located on the map is displayed there.
[*][b][u]Added: New Option to hide rail line information window while a train is focused[/u][/b] 
While having a train selected, a new “Retract” button is now available to hide the UI. The button is located below the “Delete Rail Line” button.
[*][b][u]Added: New “Apply to all” button to maintenance post window[/u][/b]
The “Transfer to All” button has been added to the “Maintenance Post” menu. The button behaves the same as the “Transfer to All” button from the Maintenance depot. When clicking this button, the current settings of the selected building are applied to all other buildings of the same type.
[*][b][u]Added: Path of goods through warehouses to “Flow of goods”[/u] [/b]
When selecting resources in the “Flow of Goods” menu, the overlay now also shows the path of goods through warehouses.
[*][b][u]Added: New ”Number of citizens” metric to city list[/u][/b]
When selecting “Cities” in the “City List” menu, the number of “Citizens” is now displayed below each city name.
[*][b][u]Added: Last camera position in ”Ride along” mode is now saved[/u] [/b]
The last camera position used during a “Ride Along” is now saved when leaving and reentering this mode.
[*][b][u]Added: After adding a new station building, the buildings information window will open so that the player can make adjustments to the new building [/u][/b]
After building a new extension at a train station through the “Construction Extension” menu, the newly created building’s overlay is now immediately displayed.
[*][b][u]Added: New ”Switch between cities” arrow buttons in the city information window[/u] [/b]
When selecting an owned city, arrow icons to switch between player owned cities are now displayed in the city overlay next to the its name.
[*][b][u]Added: New arrows showcasing connections between rail line stops when constructing/viewing a rail line [/u][/b]
While creating or editing a new rail line, the connections between train stations are now additionally indicated with arrows pointing between the different connections.
[*][b][u]Added: New Option to adjust volume of locomotive sounds[/u] [/b]
The “Trains” sound slider has been added to the Sound Options menu. The sound volume of trains can now be separately adjusted via this menu.
[*][b][u]Added: Currently selected train is now highlighted in Rail Lines overview [/u][/b]
When selecting a train, the corresponding train in the “Rail Lines” menu will now be highlighted with an arrow pointer.
[*][b][u]Added: New Warning in rail line information window if prioritized goods couldn't be transported (automatic loading)[/u][/b]
A new warning has been added if a rail line is unable to transport prioritized goods. When hovering over the exclamation mark, a detailed message with the reason why the prioritized good can’t be transported is now displayed. 
[*][b][u]Added: New Warning in the rail line information window if goods couldn't be loaded (manual loading) [/u][/b]
A new warning has been added if a rail line is unable to load prioritized goods. When hovering over the exclamation mark, a detailed message with the reason why the prioritized good can’t be loaded is now displayed. Example: “Unable to load prioritized good. Unable to load [resource] in [train station]: No demand for this good”.
[*][b][u]Added: Increased character limit while naming train lines to 69[/u][/b] [/list]

[h3]Further adjustments[/h3]
[list][*][u][b]The maximum engine speed of several locomotive engines has been adjusted.[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Maximum engine speed for Inyo, Mountain and Texas increased.
[*] Maximum engine speed for Forquenot, T16, P8, and Bay AA_I decreased.
[/list]
[*][u][b]Reduced speed when using the "ride along" feature [/b][/u]
The game speed in the “Ride Along” feature has been adjusted to give a better viewing experience while following the train.
[*][u][b]Various smaller improvements on wagons, like reduced initial dirt, missing lights, colors, etc.[/b][/u]
Several visual improvements have been made to train wagons. Adding visual effects like lights, improvements to colors and objects, fixed “level of details” with some wagon types, and reduced dirtiness / dirt levels on a new train are a few of the additions.
[*][u][b]Reduced water consumption of waiting trains [/b][/u]
Waiting trains now consume less water when they are stationary. This means they need fewer stops at the “Supply Tower”. [/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the research for speed bonus was also applied to all future locomotives of other decades, instead of only engines of the same decade. This fix only applies to new save games. 
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch in the "Manual Loading" interface where it looked like you could unload goods in cities that don’t have demand for that good. 
[*] Fixed an issue with manual signals where trains didn't detect the next viable stop correctly. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Refrigerator car was always unlocked on Europe map. 
[*] Fixed some issues where goods sometimes weren't properly transported via warehouses. 
[*] Fixed an issue with task generation where the player had to connect too many cities to the network. 
[*] Fixed an issue where automatically built factories were positioned in front of train stations, blocking future track construction. 
[*] [b][Controller][/b] Fixed an issue where players were unable to confirm track priority. 
[*] Fixed some text-alignment issues within the Arabic localization. 
[*] [b][Journey to the East][/b] Fixed an issue where, in some eras wrong luxury wagons were displayed. 
[*] [b][Journey to the East][/b] Fixed an issue where Seasonal Snow was not available on the Balkans map. 
[*] [b][Journey to the East][/b] Fixed an issue where luxury passengers weren't loading and unloading properly. 
[/list]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.2[/h1]

[i]Tycoons![/i]

[b]We have just delivered Railway Empire 2’s Update 1.2[/b] alongside our [b]first DLC, Journey to the East[/b] for Steam, Xbox Game Pass across console and PC Game Pass for PC, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery).
This update includes several fixes, such as fixes for manual signals and for blocked gridirons. 

[i]Please find the full Changelog below.[/i]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.1[/h1]

[i]Tycoons![/i]

We have just delivered Railway Empire 2’s massive Update 1.1 for Steam, Xbox Game Pass across console and PC Game Pass for PC, the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery):
When Railway Empire 2 was released, a lot of you expressed a desire for more control regarding your signals. We have been working hard to respond to your wishes, and with this update we have implemented the ability to choose how you place your signals. [b]Automatic signaling mode[/b] with track directions is the recommended way to play Railway Empire 2, but for those of you who would prefer to take full control over your Railway system, the new [b]"Manual" mode[/b] can now be selected at the start of a new game. Please note that you have to select one of the two systems at the start of a game and these modes cannot be changed afterwards and are incompatible with each other.

We have also implemented some [b]additional tweaks to the train logic[/b], [b]Interface[/b] and, among other things, have [b]added the option to play your game at x5 speed[/b] (PC Only). Furthermore, we have added [b]improvements to the warehouses[/b] to address goods that did not reach their destination.

[i]Please find the full Changelog below.[/i]

[h3]Signals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added manual Signal Mode as a separate game mode where the player can place signals manually:

[list][*] When starting a new game, you can now choose between two different signal modes: "Automatic (recommended)" and "Manual". Since the two systems are incompatible with each other, you must decide at the beginning of a game and cannot change the mode during a running game.
[*] In "Manual" mode you may place individual "stop" and "directional" signals, or place several signals at once within a certain distance. You can also remove all signals on a track section.
[*] All signals allow a train to wait at them if the next signal section is used by another train. Sometimes trains stop at signals even though the next section is free to avoid blockages. "Directional signals" allow trains to pass in one direction only, "Stop signals" may be used in both directions and are primarily intended to divide long tracks into several sections.
[*] This mode is intended for more experienced players, as with great power comes great responsibility: If you do not set up your signals correctly, blockages will occur! [/list]
[*] Fixed a bug where signals did not update on competitors track properly, after the AI has built new tracks, resulting in sub optimal signal placement.
[*] Fixed signal positioning at gridirons so that signals no longer spawn in the middle of the track.
[/list]

[h3]Warehouse[/h3]
These fixes address reported issues of "trains not delivering goods" and "goods not reaching their destination".
[list]
[*] The farther away a factory or farm from a well-supplied city, the less likely it is, that goods will be delivered to that city. If a city is undersupplied, goods will be delivered anyway.
[*] Added additional tooltips to cities and warehouses showing detailed information about goods in transit.
[*] Added some hints and warnings if goods are not picked up from warehouses due to insufficient trains.
[/list]

[h3]Train logic[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where goods were not delivered, while a waypoint in route planning.
[*] Fixed some rare cases in which trains were not entering track segments.
[*] Fixed an issue where trains were waiting for other trains that were behind them.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where trains were stuck after refueling at supply towers.
[/list]

[h3]Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added option to enable x5 game speed. [PC ONLY]
[*] Added option to display/not display warnings.
[*] Added option to skip non-tutorial voice messages from characters.
[*] Added option to adjust scroll speed.
[*] Moved the "Icons at Edge of Screen" option from “Display” to “Gameplay “
[/list]

[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some layout problems within newspapers.
[*] Users are now able to input non-Latin-alphabet text.
[*] Maintenance costs are now properly displayed in the quarterly report.
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the refrigerator car was available without unlocking the tech.
[*] Fixed some performance issues during videos.
[*] Fixed a bug where AI competitors would participate in auctions even if 100% of their shares were owned by the player.
[*] Further stability improvements and smaller bugfixes.
[*] Fixed several tutorial soft blocks.
[*] Trains without sufficient water supply now have their max speed halved instead of only their acceleration speed being halved.
[/list]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Hotfix for Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Hotfix for Update 1.0.3 [/h1]


[i]Tycoons,[/i]

We have just released a Hotfix for Update 1.0.3, which readjusted and fixed the priority of delivering wares and we wanted to share some additional insights with you all.
The issues noticed were mainly related to the calculation of priority in the underlying code and now that it is fixed we wanted to take a moment to elaborate on how it is decided which good goes where and why first.

At the start of their journey, the following is considered for the wares:
The assessment is based on the nearest city that has a demand for the goods, whose import storage is not full and can be reached by the current city.
Already declared goods in the cities and goods consumed during the scheduled travel time are also taken into account.
[b]The priority of cities in need of goods is decided via 2 factors: [/b]
[olist]
[*]The most important factor is the distance the goods would need to travel to reach their target. This refers to the length of the rail connecting the starting point and goal, not the direct distance. For reference: the length of a station is 200 meters.
[*]In case this distance is similiar in length, the amount of times the goods would have to change trains is also taken into account. The higher this number is, the lower the priority of the city. [/olist]

Based on this, the following Formula applies:
[i]1 – D / 5000 – U / 10[/i]

D = Distance in meters to the destination, counting the length of the tracks leading there, not their actual distance
U = Amount of track changes that would be needed, due to warehouses and goods changing trains

With this formula/prioritization for prioritization laid out, the goods would be delivered to each city, until the storage of the city is full and then proceed to reserve goods for the next city in the priority line.

[b]To summarize, this means that, the closer the city expecting the goods is to the warehouse and the more direct the connection is without warehouses, the more priority is given. The distance value is the most important[/b]. 

[i]In case there is still something that you think is working incorrectly about the warehouses after the update, please report it to us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1644320/discussions/2/]Bug-Report Subforum[/url], so we can have a closer look at it![/i]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.0.3 [/h1]
  

[i]Tycoons! [/i]

[b]Today we are delivering Railway Empire 2’s first big update for Steam, Xbox Game Pass for console and PC Game Pass for PC, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery):[/b] Aboard the freight train there are over 100 fixes, including changes to the train logic and track construction, improving trains passing each other on free tracks, as well as fixing misplaced signals on a 4-track gridiron. Also, we’ve fixed several issues with waypoints not working properly and the Mallard engine now plays the correct sounds. 

Aside from the train logic and track construction, we’ve made several changes to the UI, sound, task lists, multiplayer, bugfixes, gameplay, achievements, and many other issues. 
Please find the full Changelog below. 

This update will lay the tracks for the future improvements to Railway Empire 2, so please stay tuned and don’t forget to check out the first Roadmap for the game if you have missed it: 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1644320/view/3672170635430641775?l=english 

We encourage you to keep sharing your feedback on the forums https://steamcommunity.com/app/1644320/discussions/3/ and discord.  

[i]Your Railway Empire 2 Team [/i]

 

[h2]Train Logic[/h2]
[list][*] Improved train logic where a waiting train in a station could block other train tracks and might cause traffic jams.  
[*]  Improved train logic for passing other trains when possible, rather than waiting for them in switching zones.   
[*]  Improved the priority calculation behind unloading goods.  
[*]  Fixed an issue where trains would wrongfully reverse at a station after building a new track. 
[*]  Trains will no longer stop at train stations on their route if there are no actions possible.  
[*]  Fixed an issue where trains sometimes would glitch into and block each other. 
[*]  Fixed AI delivering goods to a city from a distant point, blocking goods consumption due to not receiving the delivery.  
[*]  Fixed an issue with broken waypoints interrupting rail line operation.  
[*] Fixed an issue with signals close to supply towers sometimes wrongfully closing, leading trains to stop unnecessarily.  
[*]  Fixed an issue where wares could not reach their target city destination when being transported through a chain of warehouses, especially when two warehouses were built in close proximity to each other. 
[*]  Fixed an issue where placed waypoints within a train route could lead to trains skipping train stations and generally not behaving as intended.  
[*] Fixed an issue where trains could not be refuelled at a supply tower due to the supply tower’s signal not being detected correctly. For save games from before this update, simply change the track direction, so that the signals update themselves.  
[*]  Fixed an issue with the calculation of the locomotive maintenance, ensuring all bonuses are considered and calculated correctly.  [/list]

[h2]Track Construction [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed additional tracks being displayed during girdiron construction when the respective platforms do not exist due to limited available space at the station.  
[*] Fixed an issue where unselected tracks were wrongly highlighted while defining track direction.  
[*] Fixed an issue in topographical mode where a switch between crossing tracks was sometimes not displayed correctly.  
[*] When constructing a track using a controller, it is now possible to automatically snap to the closest track by pressing the corresponding direction on the D-Pad.  
[*] Fixed an issue where signals were sometimes misplaced when constructing a 4-track gridiron.  
[*] Fixed an issue where it would sometimes be possible to place waypoints.  
[*] To improve waypoint placing using the controller, the track the player is hovering over now displays the waypoint cone in advance. 
[*] Fixed an issue where parallel tracks were sometimes unnecessarily built as bridges. 
[*] Fixed an issue where parallel crossing tracks were constructed incorrectly at the track junction.  
[*] Fixed an issue where building parallel tracks could lead to the parallel track being built in disconnected segments. [/list]

[h2]UI [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed cumulative bonuses not being displayed in the info box of some technologies. 
[*] Fixed the number of train cars being displayed incorrectly when using special cars (e.g. the refrigerator car). 
[*] Fixed the “regions” button disappearing in some cases. 
[*] Fixed quarterly report showing maintenance costs when no maintenance post or depots are being used. 
[*] Fixed route lists at train stations still being accessible after station’s last train was deleted. 
[*] Fixed the camera focus not centering on the connection bonus city when clicking on the connection bonus icon. 
[*] Fixed loading screen showing unsupported files when other files than save games are copied into the save game folder. 
[*] Ratings window is now showing which campaign, chapter, or which specific scenario was played.  
[*] Fixed cities now displaying which goods are being produced when building a new train station.  
[*] Fixed display of areas suitable for building during factory construction when the selected factory cannot be built in the selected city. 
[*] Fixed the “tips and tricks” screen not being closed correctly in the main menu when opened via hot-key. 
[*] The number of wagons now cycles properly when used manually. 
[*] Improved controller navigation when changing the order of stations while editing or creating a rail line. 
[*] In the Personnel interface, bonuses from research that affect the cost are now visually indicated via an arrow icon. Hovering over this icon displays more details on these bonuses. 
[*] Fixed an issue where values were wrongly displayed in the newspaper.  
[*] The total research bonuses in the research menu are now correctly displayed for engine reliability. 
[*] Fixed an issue, where scrolling in the Goods Supply and Demand page also changed the zoom level in the gameworld. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the schematic track representation disappeared when opening the list of routes and selecting a train. 
[*] Changed the controller key assignment so that it is now possible to open the auction bidding during track construction. 
[*] City names are now displayed in the building menu (e.g. when constructing train stations). 
[*] Fixed the express tooltips not including bonuses from the engineer or entrepreneur characters. 
[*] Fixed maintenance post cost not being included in the calculation for the average balance per week in the company menu. 
[*] Fixed the cash icon not being displayed in the newspaper. 
[*] Fixed a research node being researchable even without an existing connection to other research nodes. 
[*] Fixed an issue in the save game menu, where after changing the language some of the map information was not displayed correctly. 
[*] Fixed issues with the font in the save game menu for several languages (Arabic, Chinese, Japanese) 
[*] Fixed an issue where the maintenance post’s green influence circle was not displayed when selecting a maintenance post while a different maintenance post was already selected. 
[*] Fixed an issue where track directions were displayed within train stations even though it is not required. Now when selecting a route, the tracks are highlighted within stations, but no track direction will be displayed within the station. 
[*] When using a controller editing a train route, the confirm option is now only displayed if there were any changes to the route that can be confirmed. 
[*] Changed the order of goods being displayed when changing goods in a warehouse, so that basic goods are displayed in a more prominent position. [/list]

[h2]Tasks List [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where missions in the task list would ask for either resources or the connection of rural businesses that would not appear within the task’s timeframe. 
[*] Fixed the scoring screen sometimes displaying a score of 0. 
[*] The name of the scenario or campaign is now also displayed in the task list. 
[*] Fixed task “gain access to 4 regions” only updating after loading a save game. 
[*] Added informational hint for task “Ensure 95% train utilization” to help the player understand what needs to be done. 
[*] Fixed “Produce X loads of X” task only counting goods produced in cities. 
[*] Fixed a hint for a particular task that was missing and led to the incorrect assumption that the task could not be completed. 
[*] Fixed the task “Ensure 95% train utilization for freight in …” not working properly. [/list]

[h2]Tutorial [/h2]
[list][*] Tutorial 2: Fixed confirmation button being hidden by the dialogue textbox for some resolutions.  
[*] Tutorial 2: Fixed an issue, where switching to the track construction tab was not possible.  
[*] Tutorial 2: Fixed an issue in Tutorial 2 where it was possible to select train routes other than the intended ones.  
[*] Tutorial 3: Locomotives can no longer break down in this tutorial mission.  
[*] Tutorial 3: Fixed some trains not counting for the “select a train line once more” request.  
[*] Tutorial 3: Fixed an issue where it was not possible to select locomotives having a breakdown.  
[*] Tutorial 4: Sacramento will now start with a larger population and grow faster within this tutorial mission.  
[*] Tutorial 4: Reworked San Francisco <-> Sacramento tracks to allow smaller grid iron placement.  
[*] Tutorial 4: Fixed an issue where the dialogue to edit locomotives could not open when using a controller.  
[*] Tutorial 5: Disabled any random auctions appearing and interfering with the tutorial flow.  
[*] Tutorial 5: Fixed player having insufficient money to participate in auction in some cases. Now additional money is granted before an auction is initiated.  
[*] Tutorial 5: Fixed an issue where the game would be stuck when the player bought a business too early into the tutorial.  
[*] Tutorial 7: Fixed conditional blocker when player starts searching for a saboteur before he is supposed to.  
[*] Tutorial 7: Fixed an issue where the Tips & Tricks button in the competitor screen was not accessible. [/list] 

[h2]Sound [/h2]
[list][*] Added additional sounds to interactions/UI interactions. 
[*] Fixed and improved whistle/horn sounds of trains. 
[*] Fixed Mallard engine not playing the correct sounds. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the whistle/horn didn’t turn off within the Engine Shed when quickly switching to a sub menu.  
[*] Fixed an issue where, after setting the audio volume to 0% and restarting the game, an additional audio sound could be heard. [/list]

[h2]Multiplayer [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed demolishing not working as intended for host and client. 
[*] Fixed inconsistent amounts of goods’ supply and demand getting displayed for host and client player.  
[*] Fixed the game crashing for a player who is upgrading an industry while another player is demolishing it.  
[*] Fixed client player being unable to access the first train station expansion in some cases.  
[*] Fixed the game crashing for player in ride-along mode while another player changes the colour of the engine.  
[*] Unavailable multiplayer sessions can now be deleted from the multiplayer menu.  
[*] Fixed client player not being able to build train station expansions before a first route was connected to a new train station.  
[*] Streamlined the buy buildings auction so that only the host player can now initiate and participate in the auctions.  
[*] Disabled “pause when game loses focus” option for multiplayer games.  
[*] Fixed the train marker arrow not shifting to newly established train for client.  
[*] Fixed an issue where unused slots were displayed as being spectators if the client player joined a lobby in the 4th slot.  
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could not increase the maintenance limit to 100% when using a controller.  
[*] Fixed an issue where, during track construction, the topography map could not be displayed during multiplayer.  
[*] Fixed an issue where it was not possible for the client to demolish owned buildings.  
[*] Fixed an issue where the quarterly report could differ between the client and host players.  
[*] PS5: Fixed an issue, where using the “Restart Activity” function in multiplayer mode would lead to UI overlapping after loading into the main menu.  
[*] Fixed an issue where the message “spectatormode activated” would appear even though no spectators could join the game and no spectators were active.  
[*] Improved an issue where sometimes entering a multiplayer mode did not work and led to an error message. [/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list][*] Bugfix: In the Scenario „The Southern Route“, it is now no longer possible to demolish prebuilt tracks in the locked areas. 
[*] Bugfix: The research bonus given by the “Trolley” (unlockable during the 1840s), which reduces the cost of maintenance post by 5%, is now applied properly. 
[*] Bugfix: Fixed the “Center View on Object” option during an auction not working when currently having the “Center View on Train” option in use. 
[*] Bugfix: Fixed an issue where the saboteur would stop working when the last remaining competitor had been bought. 
[*] Bugfix: Fixed an issue where the AI opponent could place waypoints in blocked height ranges. This could lead to issues with the game’s performance or crashes. 
[*] Bugfix: Fixed an issue where businesses could be located outside of the playable area. 
[*] Bugfix: Fixed an issue where new city building spaces did not unlock after reaching the required population. 
[*] Bugfix: The F11-key can no longer be assigned to the photo mode, as this could cause a soft lock. 
[*] Bugfix: Fixed an issue where the game could crash, when the highest bidding opponent is bought, and the company merged during an action.  
[*] Bugfix: Fixed an issue where the player could receive refund higher than the initial investment when demolishing bridges.  
[*] Sabotage: Fixed an issue, where trains were still being loaded even though sabotage should have prevented this from being possible at a specific train station.  
[*] Gameplay: Fixed connection bonuses not being rewarded properly. The system to check whether a connection bonus should be received has been improved.  
[*] Gameplay: Fixed an issue where station extensions (restaurant, post-office, market hall) were generating more revenue than intended in their bonuses.  
[*] Gameplay: Fixed an issue where the list of trains affected by a Maintenance Post were not updated properly.  
[*] Gameplay: Fixed an issue where wares were not being requested by cities even though they had reached the appropriate population size.  
[*] Gameplay: Fixed an issue where the train consumption would be displayed as 0%.  
[*] Gameplay: The AI opponents will now try to place their initial headquarters in a city directly neighboring the player’s headquarters. 
[*] Gameplay: Fixed an issue where the cost of some businesses was calculated incorrectly.  
[*] Gameplay: The Caboose bonus is now added independently of the maximum possible personnel efficiency bonus.  
[*] Balancing: Inflation scaling is now adjusted depending on the starting year. The inflation scaling has been increased overall for auctions and Buildings.  
[*] Exploit: Fixed an exploit, that allowed the buying and immediate selling of company shares to generate money.  
[*] Campaign: Fixed an issue where the player could demolish tracks within restricted areas.  
[*] Campaign: Fixed an issue in campaign 3 where it was not possible to buy shares from Walter Pajonk’s company, which was required for a task.  
[*] Campaign: Fixed an issue in campaign 2 where it was sometimes not possible to build a route between the two required destinations in Dec. 1852.  
[*] Campaign/Scenarios: Several technical adjustments to the Campaign and different scenarios (in France and Germany) regarding region unlocks. 
[*] Achievement: “Together We Stand” achievement can now be unlocked in all modes as intended instead of only in free play.  
[*] Achievement: Fixed the “Hostile takeover” and the “Assimilated” achievement being unlockable through unintended methods.  
[*] Achievement: “Call of Duty” achievement can now be unlocked as intended.  
[*] Achievement: Fixed an issue with the “Max Power” achievement being unlockable through upgrading city’s factories instead of rural businesses.  
[*] Achievement: The "Let off some steam" achievement can now be completed through all means of sabotage.  
[*] Report Issue Functionality: Fixed the “Report Issue” function not opening the location of the save game in some cases.  
[*] Graphics: Fixed tunnels visually overlapping with each other in some instances.  
[*] Graphics: Adjusted the beginning of game camera settings, so that the camera always centers on to the player headquarters. 
[*] Art: Fixed the lip movement of avatars sometimes not being displayed correctly. 
[*] SteamDeck: The game now correctly defaults to external Bluetooth/USB controllers on the SteamDeck. [/list]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Hotfix 1.0.2[/h1]

notes.title: Track to Release - From Beta Station to Release City
notes.notes:
[h1]Take a look back on our journey to release![/h1]

Tycoons,
 
The ride towards our destination “Release City” was an exciting one for us, and we’d like to recap our journey and have a look at the ride so far.
From December 6th to 20th in 2022, we had an exciting closed beta to which far more players applied than we expected. Seeing the enthusiasm for the game this far ahead of release was inspiring for us!

 The detailed and plentiful feedback we have received has been carefully evaluated, along with all the constructive criticism and helpful suggestions that were given to us by our community during our Beta.

 Below, you can have a glimpse at some of these major changes, already implemented as a result of Beta player’s feedback, with many more for you to be excited about at the Railway Empire 2 Release-Station:
 

[h2]Important Changes[/h2]
As any good train ride needs a well-built track, we have implemented some important changes to ensure the ride will be a smooth one and live up to our passengers' high expectations.
[list]
[*]Custom Game settings are now more advanced to provide a more customisable experience. Please stay tuned, more details will follow, but just to spoil a few of them: You can now choose the Inflation Rate, Transportation Revenue, the cost of tracks and Maintenance, among other things.
[*]The warehouse can now be unlocked right at the start of the campaign. Originally this was a lot further down the tech tree, but your feedback underlined the importance of this strategically essential building.
[*]We have implemented a dynamic technology tree wherein older technologies might become available for purchase or through events. 
[*]The time for bidding is now longer, to make sure you can take your time to carefully read through the auction details.
[*]Sandbox maps now have the option to be played without a time limit.
[*]After numerous requests, double track building has now been added! It is as simple as pressing a single button after creating a track as usual.
[*]Track crossings are now possible.
[*]You can now quickly recognise and distinguish between freight and post/passenger trains via additional symbols in the track lists.
[*]To make it clear at which size a new industry building gets unlocked in a town, we have made that information visible to the player.
[*]We have made it clearer that you need a university to grow your city if you already filled the special city slot with another building like the library. [/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
Furthermore, we have been working on improvements to the quality of life of your gameplay experience, to make sure you find the ride enjoyable. Below you can find some examples of these changes:
[list]
[*]Auctions can now be minimized so that you have the chance to issue a bond to pay for it.
[*]Windows can now be closed by using the Escape button to be more in line with player expectations.
[*]An arrow now gives a visual indicator on the currently selected object (e.g. a train or a building)
[*]Added automatic savegames when a task group was completed, so that the player can fall back to when each set of tasks were completed.
[*]Three different font size settings have been added to improve readability.
[*]You can now fully cycle through the number of cars in the train set-up on your train from 8 down to 0.
[*]Additional customizable keyboard shortcuts have been added (e.g. build supply tower, build train station, etc)
[*]Auctions now have a description of what the offered technologies do, allowing for an educated decision worthy of a terrific tycoon!
[*]It is now possible to scroll the map using your mouse. You can enable this feature via the settings. Furthermore, there are now additional options in the in-game settings for you to choose from.
[*]Thanks to your notes, we have added more tooltips to the game.
[*]Autosave intervals have been shortened to 5 minutes for a safety net with less lost progress.
[/list]

notes.notes:
